stem: Since the first commercial oil well in the United States was drilled in Pennsylvania in 1859, petroleum ____ one of the world's most important sources of energy.

stem: The Eiffel Tower ____ for the 1889 World's Fair in Paris.

stem: Mary Anning was a fossil collector ____ discoveries along the English coast changed scientific ideas about prehistoric life.

stem: Economists continue to debate ____ raising the minimum wage reduces employment.

stem: ____ a large part of their country lies below sea level, the Dutch have built an extensive system of dikes, dams, and pumps.

stem: ____ into the desert floor of southern Peru, the Nazca Lines are best viewed from the air.
